title: Fidus Achates!
html_source: Latin for “the faithful Achates”. Achates was a close buddy and companion of Aeneas' in Virgil’s Aeneid. Unlike Buck Mulligan, Achates doesn’t say much. As Mr. Dedalus uses it, the phrase is a cliche, but in the context of Hades it alludes to Achates' role in support of Aeneas as Aeneas gets ready for the fearful voyage to the underworld.
